title: Westlake Reports Q3 2026 Earnings on $3.0 Billion Net Sales
summary: Westlake reported Q3 2026 net sales of $3.0 billion and net income of $6 million, or $0.05 per share; $0.45 per share excluding Identified Items.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News - Westlake ([WLK](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/wlk/) ) reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $3.0 billion and net income of $6 million, or $0.05 per diluted share, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, according to[Westlake's official earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1262823/000126282326000076/ex991_20260930earningsrele.htm) . Excluding Identified Items, net income was $58 million, or $0.45 per share.

## Westlake Earnings Details


Third-quarter net sales were $2,981 million, compared with $2,838 million in the third quarter of 2025. Net income attributable to Westlake was $6 million, or $0.05 per diluted share, against a net loss of $782 million, or $6.06 per share, a year earlier. Excluding Identified Items, net income was $58 million, or $0.45 per share, compared with a net loss of $38 million, or $0.29 per share. EBITDA excluding Identified Items was $408 million, up 30% from $313 million. Identified Items were $56 million of charges for previously announced facility shutdowns and $2 million of other restructuring costs.
